gaps.title: Missing access controls on generated analytical reports
gaps.jtbd: When an analytical report is generated, I want its access restricted based on the user's department and courses, so that closed reports are not globally accessible.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a user generates an analytical report, When the DossierReport is saved, Then its accessDepartment and accessCourse fields must be populated from the user's Moodle department and courses.

gaps.title: Incorrect OAuth2 authorization code exchange
gaps.jtbd: When a user logs in via Moodle SSO, I want the system to properly exchange the OAuth2 authorization code for an access token, so that it can securely fetch the user's profile.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a Moodle authorization code, When the system processes the callback, Then it must first call the token endpoint to exchange the code for an access token before calling the userinfo endpoint.
